primary_endpoint: Change in serum alanine transaminase level at 24 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Semaglutide reduced serum alanine transaminase (mean difference 14.07 U/L; 95% CI 19.39 to -8.75; p<0.001).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events were more frequent versus placebo (RR 1.54; 95% CI 1.02–2.34; p=0.04); common events included gastrointestinal and gallbladder-related disorders.
